verses.text_urhobo: Etiyin Josẹf da yanran ra ta ki Fero, Ọsẹ mẹ vẹ emesẹ mẹ vẹ uchuru rayen vẹ eranvwe kugbe eyere rayen ejobi, nẹ otọ ri Kenan rhire, ayen obi Goshẹn Asakiephana.
verses.text_romanized: etiyin josef da yanran ra ta ki fero ose me ve emese me ve uchuru rayen ve eranvwe kugbe eyere rayen ejobi ne oto ri kenan rhire ayen obi goshen asakiephana

verses.text_urhobo: O da reyọ eshare iyori vwẹ usun re emesẹ rọye ọ da vwẹ ayen nẹ Fero
verses.text_romanized: o da reyo eshare iyori vwe usun re emese roye o da vwe ayen ne fero

verses.text_urhobo: Fero da ta kẹ emesẹ rọye, Didi iruo we ruẹ? Aye da kpahe ki Fero, Idibo wẹn isuigodẹ kirobo rẹ esẹ rẹ avwanre ruru.
verses.text_romanized: fero da ta ke emese roye didi iruo we rue aye da kpahe ki fero idibo wen isuigode kirobo re ese re avwanre ruru

verses.text_urhobo: Ayen da ta ki Fero, Avwanre rhe ukane vwẹ otọ na, kidie a rha mrẹ egbri vwọ kẹ igodẹ rẹ idibo wẹ-ẹn, fiki rẹ owẹvwe na ganọ vwẹ obo otọ ri Kenan, Asakiephana avwanre rẹ wẹ, jẹn idibo wẹn dia otọ ri Goshẹn na.
verses.text_romanized: ayen da ta ki fero avwanre rhe ukane vwe oto na kidie a rha mre egbri vwo ke igode re idibo we en fiki re owevwe na gano vwe obo oto ri kenan asakiephana avwanre re we jen idibo wen dia oto ri goshen na

verses.text_urhobo: Etiyin Fero da ta ki Josẹf, Ọsẹ wẹn vẹ emesẹ wẹn bru vwe rhe.
verses.text_romanized: etiyin fero da ta ki josef ose wen ve emese wen bru vwe rhe

verses.text_urhobo: Otọ rẹ Ijipt na ejobi obọ wẹn ọ epha; jẹn ọsẹ wẹn vẹ emesẹ wẹn dia asan ro Me yovwi vwẹ otọ na; jẹn ayen dia otọ ri Goshẹn, wọ da rha mrẹ ohwo rọ ganre vwẹ usun rayen, gbe jọ vwẹ ẹro te eranvwe mẹ.
verses.text_romanized: oto re ijipt na ejobi obo wen o epha jen ose wen ve emese wen dia asan ro me yovwi vwe oto na jen ayen dia oto ri goshen wo da rha mre ohwo ro ganre vwe usun rayen gbe jo vwe ero te eranvwe me

verses.text_urhobo: Josẹf da reyọ ọsẹ rọye Jekọp rhe o de mudia vwẹ obaro ri Fero, Jekọp da nẹ ẹrhovwo ki Fero.
verses.text_romanized: josef da reyo ose roye jekop rhe o de mudia vwe obaro ri fero jekop da ne erhovwo ki fero

verses.text_urhobo: Fero da ta ki Jekọp, Bro ikpe wọ dia akpọ re?
verses.text_romanized: fero da ta ki jekop bro ikpe wo dia akpo re

verses.text_urhobo: Jekọp da ta ki Fero, Me akpọ ikpe ujosan gbẹ ihwe re, ehahavwe e ke je vọn vẹ ọdjarhe, vwẹ enana ejobi na Me je tọn te esẹ mẹ-ẹ.
verses.text_romanized: jekop da ta ki fero me akpo ikpe ujosan gbe ihwe re ehahavwe e ke je von ve odjarhe vwe enana ejobi na me je ton te ese me e

verses.text_urhobo: Jekọp da nẹ ẹrhovwo ki Fero, ọ da yan nẹ obaro ri Fero.
verses.text_romanized: jekop da ne erhovwo ki fero o da yan ne obaro ri fero

verses.text_urhobo: Etiyin Josẹf da vwẹ asan kẹ ọsẹ rọye vẹ emesẹ rọye dia, ọ da ghare ẹkẹn kẹ ayen vwẹ otọ rẹ Ijipt, asan ro Me yovwi vwẹ otọ na, vwẹ otọ ri Ramsis, kirobo ri Fero dje kẹ.
verses.text_romanized: etiyin josef da vwe asan ke ose roye ve emese roye dia o da ghare eken ke ayen vwe oto re ijipt asan ro me yovwi vwe oto na vwe oto ri ramsis kirobo ri fero dje ke

verses.text_urhobo: Josẹf kọye re ghẹrẹ ọsẹ rọye vẹ emesẹ rọye kugbe evwruwevwi rẹ ọsẹ rọye ejobi, ọtiobo rẹ unu re ria emu vwẹ uwevwi rayen bute.
verses.text_romanized: josef koye re ghere ose roye ve emese roye kugbe evwruwevwi re ose roye ejobi otiobo re unu re ria emu vwe uwevwi rayen bute

verses.text_urhobo: Asakiephana emuọre rha otọ na ejobi-i, kidie owẹvwe na firi gangan, etiọye na te otọ rẹ Ijipt vẹ otọ ri Kenan de rhi vwioro ku fiki rẹ owẹvwe na.
verses.text_romanized: asakiephana emuore rha oto na ejobi i kidie owevwe na firi gangan etioye na te oto re ijipt ve oto ri kenan de rhi vwioro ku fiki re owevwe na

verses.text_urhobo: Josẹf de koko igho ra mrẹre vwẹ otọ re Ijipt na ejobi kugbe otọ ri Kenan na ejobi, igho rẹ ọka ra dẹre, Josẹf da ghwẹ igho na phihọ uwevwi ri Fero.
verses.text_romanized: josef de koko igho ra mrere vwe oto re ijipt na ejobi kugbe oto ri kenan na ejobi igho re oka ra dere josef da ghwe igho na phiho uwevwi ri fero

verses.text_urhobo: Ọke rẹ igho rẹ otọ rẹ Ijipt kugbe otọ ri Kenan vwo re nu, ihwo rẹ Ijipt ejobi de bru Josẹf rhe, ayen da ta, Kẹ avwanre emu, die avwanre di vwo ghwu vwẹ irharo wẹn? Kidie igho rẹ avwanre reri.
verses.text_romanized: oke re igho re oto re ijipt kugbe oto ri kenan vwo re nu ihwo re ijipt ejobi de bru josef rhe ayen da ta ke avwanre emu die avwanre di vwo ghwu vwe irharo wen kidie igho re avwanre reri

verses.text_urhobo: Josẹf da kpahe, Kẹ vwẹ uchuru wẹn, ki mi vwẹ emuọre wene uchuru na kẹ wẹ, o da dianẹ igho wẹn reri.
verses.text_romanized: josef da kpahe ke vwe uchuru wen ki mi vwe emuore wene uchuru na ke we o da diane igho wen reri

verses.text_urhobo: Etiyin ayen da ghwẹ uchuru rayen rhe Josẹf; Josẹf da vwẹ emuọre wene iyesi, igodẹ, uchuru vẹ ekẹtẹkẹtẹ rayen, ọ da vwẹ emu wene uchuru rayen ejobi ukpe yena.
verses.text_romanized: etiyin ayen da ghwe uchuru rayen rhe josef josef da vwe emuore wene iyesi igode uchuru ve eketekete rayen o da vwe emu wene uchuru rayen ejobi ukpe yena

verses.text_urhobo: Rẹ ukpe yena vwo re nu, ayen de bro rhe vwẹ ukpe ro kpaherọ, ayen da ta kẹ, Avwanre sa djahe orovwovwe-e nẹ igho rẹ avwanre ejobi reri; uchuru rẹ avwanre ejobi ke e rẹ ọrovwovwe vwẹ etinẹ na; emu ọvuọvo gbi chekọ kẹ avwanre-e ọrovwovwe jokpa rẹ ugboma ofefe rẹ avwanre kugbe otọ rẹ avwanre.
verses.text_romanized: re ukpe yena vwo re nu ayen de bro rhe vwe ukpe ro kpahero ayen da ta ke avwanre sa djahe orovwovwe e ne igho re avwanre ejobi reri uchuru re avwanre ejobi ke e re orovwovwe vwe etine na emu ovuovo gbi cheko ke avwanre e orovwovwe jokpa re ugboma ofefe re avwanre kugbe oto re avwanre

verses.text_urhobo: Die sorọ rẹ avwanre di vwo ghwu vwẹ irharo wẹn, te avwanre te etọ rẹ avwanre? Dẹ avwanre kugbe etọ rẹ avwanre vwẹ ọ rẹ emuọre, te avwanre te etọ rẹ avwanre ke dia eviẹn ri Fero; kẹ avwanre emamọ, re avwanre rhọ, ru Me je ghwo, rere otọ na vwo je fue.
verses.text_romanized: die soro re avwanre di vwo ghwu vwe irharo wen te avwanre te eto re avwanre de avwanre kugbe eto re avwanre vwe o re emuore te avwanre te eto re avwanre ke dia evien ri fero ke avwanre emamo re avwanre rho ru me je ghwo rere oto na vwo je fue

verses.text_urhobo: Ọtiọye na Josẹf da dẹ etọ rẹ Ijipt vwọ ki Fero, kidie ihwo rẹ Ijipt ejobi shẹ etọ rayen re, fiki rẹ owẹvwe na firi gangan. Etọ na ejobi ke ri Fero,
verses.text_romanized: otioye na josef da de eto re ijipt vwo ki fero kidie ihwo re ijipt ejobi she eto rayen re fiki re owevwe na firi gangan eto na ejobi ke ri fero

verses.text_urhobo: vwọ kẹ irere na, ọ da vwẹ ayen ru eviẹn nẹ oba rẹ Ijipt ọvo re te ọrivẹ.
verses.text_romanized: vwo ke irere na o da vwe ayen ru evien ne oba re ijipt ovo re te orive

verses.text_urhobo: Etọ rẹ irherẹn ọvo ọye o jẹ dẹ; kidie irherẹn na vwo uchosa ri Fero hwa kẹ ayen: fiki rẹ ọtiọye na ayen gbe shẹ etọ rayen.
verses.text_romanized: eto re irheren ovo oye o je de kidie irheren na vwo uchosa ri fero hwa ke ayen fiki re otioye na ayen gbe she eto rayen

verses.text_urhobo: Etiyin Josẹf da ta kẹ ihwo na, Nighe, nonẹ na Me dẹ ovwan vẹ etọ rẹ ovwan vwọ ki Fero. Enana ibi rẹ emamọ na, ovwan gba kọn otọ na.
verses.text_romanized: etiyin josef da ta ke ihwo na nighe none na me de ovwan ve eto re ovwan vwo ki fero enana ibi re emamo na ovwan gba kon oto na

verses.text_urhobo: Vwẹ ọke orhọ we gbe toro akuori vwọ ki Fero, akuẹne ri chekọ ke re ovwan, kẹ Etiyin wa da re kugbe Etiyin wa da je kọn, Etiyin uwevwi rẹ ovwan da re kugbe imitete rẹ ovwan ejobi.
verses.text_romanized: vwe oke orho we gbe toro akuori vwo ki fero akuene ri cheko ke re ovwan ke etiyin wa da re kugbe etiyin wa da je kon etiyin uwevwi re ovwan da re kugbe imitete re ovwan ejobi

verses.text_urhobo: Ayen da ta, Wo Sivwi avwanre nure, gbe je o je ọrovwovwe, avwanre ke dia eviẹn ri Fero.
verses.text_romanized: ayen da ta wo sivwi avwanre nure gbe je o je orovwovwe avwanre ke dia evien ri fero

verses.text_urhobo: Ọtiọye Josẹf vwi ro ru urhi vwẹ otọ rẹ Ijipt, urhi na ji mudia rhi te nonẹ, nẹ, Fero gbe vwo akuori rẹ orhọ, otọ rẹ irherẹn na ọvo kọye je ọ ri Fero ẹdia.
verses.text_romanized: otioye josef vwi ro ru urhi vwe oto re ijipt urhi na ji mudia rhi te none ne fero gbe vwo akuori re orho oto re irheren na ovo koye je o ri fero edia

verses.text_urhobo: Kẹ enẹ Izrẹl rhe vwọ dia otọ rẹ Ijipt, vwẹ otọ ri Goshẹn, ayen de vwo ẹkẹn vwẹ evun rọye, ayen de vwiẹ buebu gangan.
verses.text_romanized: ke ene izrel rhe vwo dia oto re ijipt vwe oto ri goshen ayen de vwo eken vwe evun roye ayen de vwie buebu gangan

verses.text_urhobo: Jekọp da dia otọ rẹ Ijipt ikpe ihwe gbẹ ighwrẹ; ọtiọye ẹdẹ ri Jekọp, kugbe ikpe rọ tọn te da dia ikpe ujughwrẹ gbẹ ighwrẹ
verses.text_romanized: jekop da dia oto re ijipt ikpe ihwe gbe ighwre otioye ede ri jekop kugbe ikpe ro ton te da dia ikpe ujughwre gbe ighwre

verses.text_urhobo: Rẹ ọke rẹ ughwu rẹ Izrẹl vwọ kẹrẹ otọ re, o de se ọmọ rọye Josẹf ọ da ta kẹ, Ọ da dianẹ ivun mẹ ghene vwerhe owẹ, gbe phi obọ wẹn phihọ otọ rẹ ekpoghowọ mẹ, ru wo vẹ nẹ wo nene uvwe yeri eyere rẹ ọghọ vẹ uyota. Wo shi vwe phihọ Ijipt rẹ,
verses.text_romanized: re oke re ughwu re izrel vwo kere oto re o de se omo roye josef o da ta ke o da diane ivun me ghene vwerhe owe gbe phi obo wen phiho oto re ekpoghowo me ru wo ve ne wo nene uvwe yeri eyere re ogho ve uyota wo shi vwe phiho ijipt re

verses.text_urhobo: ẹkẹvuọvo shi vwe kẹrẹ esẹ mẹ, mu vwe nẹ Ijipt rere wo shi vwe phihọ ogbẹ rayen. O da kpahe nẹ, Mi ru kirobo wọ tare.
verses.text_romanized: ekevuovo shi vwe kere ese me mu vwe ne ijipt rere wo shi vwe phiho ogbe rayen o da kpahe ne mi ru kirobo wo tare

verses.text_urhobo: Ọ da ta, Duvwu iyori kẹ vwẹ, o de ghine duvwu iyori kẹ. Etiyin Izrẹl de gbe uyovwi kpotọ vwẹ enu rẹ ehwa rọye.
verses.text_romanized: o da ta duvwu iyori ke vwe o de ghine duvwu iyori ke etiyin izrel de gbe uyovwi kpoto vwe enu re ehwa roye

headings.text_urhobo: Isuesun ri Josẹf vwẹ Ọke rẹ Owẹvwe vwo fie
headings.text_romanized: isuesun ri josef vwe oke re owevwe vwo fie

headings.text_urhobo: Uku ri Jekọp ro ka Oba
headings.text_romanized: uku ri jekop ro ka oba
